UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Verified Google user profile owning Bank Nusantara cloud storage and vault documents.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: Display name of the account holder

role.description: Immutable client role assigned on profile creation

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was last updated

UserVaultCore.title: UserVaultCore
UserVaultCore.description: Core Bank Nusantara accounts, active card selection, Gold 24K market config, and user settings stored as native Firestore Maps and Lists.

ownerId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching parent userId

accounts.description: Bounded list of up to 30 BankAccount objects with gold batches and coin balances

goldMarketConfig.description: Gold 24K real-time market configuration and +5% monthly history

updatedAtMs.description: Client monotonic save epoch in milliseconds for sync conflict resolution

UserVaultLedger.title: UserVaultLedger
UserVaultLedger.description: Financial ledger collections (transactions, pockets, depositos, loans, scheduled payments, favorites, notifications, chats, card upgrades, vouchers, resi).

transactions.description: Bounded list of up to 150 recent transactions

pockets.description: Bounded list of up to 60 saving pockets

depositos.description: Bounded list of up to 60 depositos

loans.description: Bounded list of up to 60 loans

scheduledPayments.description: Bounded list of up to 60 scheduled payments

favorites.description: Bounded list of up to 60 favorite recipients

notifications.description: Bounded list of up to 80 app notifications

cardlessTokens.description: Bounded list of up to 40 cardless withdrawal tokens

cardUpgrades.description: Bounded list of up to 40 card upgrade requests

pinResetRequests.description: Bounded list of up to 40 PIN reset requests

redeemCodes.description: Bounded list of up to 60 redeem codes

purchasedCodes.description: Bounded list of up to 60 purchased voucher codes

resiList.description: Bounded list of up to 60 shipping tracking records

chats.description: Bounded list of up to 100 PayChat messages

UserVaultExtras.title: UserVaultExtras
UserVaultExtras.description: Spin wheel, Sultan Empire configuration, feature security toggles, admin help requests, and update history.

spinHistory.description: Bounded list of up to 80 spin history entries

featureConfigs.description: Bounded list of up to 200 feature security config items

deletedFeatureIds.description: Bounded list of up to 200 deleted feature IDs

adminHelpRequests.description: Bounded list of up to 60 Mintol Admin help requests

appUpdates.description: Bounded list of up to 40 app update records

budgetCategories.description: Bounded list of up to 30 monthly budget categories with limits

manualExpenses.description: Bounded list of up to 200 manual expense records

budgetTxCategoryMap.description: Map of transactionId to overridden budgetCategoryId

budgetAlertHistory.description: Bounded list of up to 150 sent threshold alert keys (80% and 100%)

BugReport.title: BugReport
BugReport.description: User submitted bug report synchronized to Admin panel.

AdminRegistry.title: AdminRegistry
AdminRegistry.description: Trusted server-side registry of administrator UIDs.

/users/{userId}.description: Google authenticated user profile root document

/users/{userId}/vault/core.description: Native Map/List storage for accounts, Gold 24K config, and user settings

/users/{userId}/vault/ledger.description: Native Map/List storage for transactions, pockets, depositos, loans, and financial records

/users/{userId}/vault/extras.description: Native Map/List storage for Spin Wheel, Sultan Empire, Feature configs, and Updates

/bug_reports/{reportId}.description: Bug reports submitted by authenticated users
